purpose: Bridge controlled Product Definition semantics to the SW2018 D3 sensor without creating a second engineering authority.

C01.DATUM_A.rule: The Product Definition datum feature remains the full controlled coplanar face set. The native SW datum symbol may attach to one member face; D3 must prove that the attached face matches a member of the controlled set. A positional min/max-X heuristic is forbidden as acceptance authority.

AV_J2_LONGITUDINAL.rule: For P007 the controlled J2/C02 axis is X. A longitudinal annotation view must look perpendicular to X. Built-in Right/Left views look along X and are end views, therefore they do not satisfy AV_J2_LONGITUDINAL. Custom annotation views remain HOLD until their orientation is qualified explicitly.

material_projection.rule: Accepted names are representation aliases only; the material authority remains AISI 316L / EN 1.4404.

release_boundary: This execution contract can make D3 coherent and deterministic. It does not close L3 perturb/restore, configuration/effectivity, D8, open Product Definition claims, BOM release, or other engineering-domain gates.
